message.content:
**Classic Lasagna (about 8–10 servings)** | Category | Typical Ingredients | Notes | |----------|---------------------|-------| | **Lasagna sheets** | 12–15 sheets (no‑boil or regular) | No‑boil sheets save a step; regular sheets need boiling. | | **Meat sauce** | 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | Brown, drain fat, add onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, pepper, oregano, basil, a splash of red wine (optional). | | **Ricotta mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese, 1 egg, ½ cup grated Parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, salt, pepper | Whisk until smooth; adds creaminess. | | **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) | For gooey, melty top. | | **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated | Sprinkle on top for a golden crust. | | **Optional extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale
• Sliced mushrooms
• Roasted red peppers
• Fresh basil leaves | Add for extra flavor or nutrition. | | **Seasonings** | Salt, black pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, garlic powder | Adjust to taste. | | **Olive oil** | 1–2 Tbsp | For sautéing onions & garlic. | ### Basic Assembly Steps 1. **Cook the lasagna sheets** (if not using no‑boil). 2. **Prepare the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic → add ground meat → brown → add tomatoes & seasonings → simmer 20–30 min. 3. **Mix ricotta** with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, pepper. 4. **Layer**: sauce → sheets → ricotta mixture → mozzarella → sauce → sheets → ricotta → mozzarella → Parmesan. 5. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 35–45 min, covered with foil then uncovered for the last 10 min to brown. 6. **Rest** 10–15 min before slicing. Feel free to tweak quantities or add your favorite veggies—lasagna is wonderfully adaptable!
